bibl.title: Dedica onoraria per Tolemeo III e Berenice.
bibl.seg: Giuditta Mirizio, Dedica onoraria per Tolemeo III e Berenice.
bibl.note: I. Cret. II, XIX No. 2. Inscription in honour of the king Ptolemy III and his wife, the queen Berenice II, on behalf of the inhabitants of Falasarna in Crete.
